candidate.data_scope: Quantiacs cryptodaily OHLCV plus historical is_liquid only

hypothesis.primary: Sequentially refining the liquid candidate set while abstaining from any refinement that would leave fewer than three names can preserve high-quality relative-strength information without the brittleness of forcing all predicates or summing them into a fixed vote threshold.
hypothesis.structural_inspiration: Finite-state monotone refinement plus abstention when a refinement over-prunes the candidate state; no learned LDT component and no transfer of formal soundness claims.

controls.base_sharpe7: Exact promoted Sharpe7 Vol2 formula copied byte-for-formula as the incumbent control.
controls.vote4: Collapse the predicates into a static 4-of-5 vote gate.
controls.reverse_descent: Use the same abstaining descent but reverse the predicate order.
controls.anti_quality: Invert the first quality predicate while preserving the rest of the descent mechanics.

selection_rule.candidate_must_not_be_materially_worse_t: Sharpe delta must be >= -0.05 at 4% ATR cost on 2016-2022
selection_rule.cost_stress: Candidate Sharpe must remain > 1.0 at 8% ATR cost on 2016-2022 to advance.
selection_rule.reverse_order: If reverse_descent beats descent, the fixed-order mechanism claim is falsified; reverse_descent is not promoted from this experiment.
